interface.shortDescription: Deprecated: use Video Studio and Marketing Images
interface.longDescription: Deprecated. New campaign videos belong in Video Studio and campaign images in Marketing Images, both working inside campaign-manager's campaign workspace. These eleven skills remain only so existing Marketing Creative video projects can be resumed, revised and exported. Each skill names its replacement. The Veo helper no longer runs, because Google shut down Veo in the Gemini API on 2026-10-22.
defaultPrompt: Use marketing-video to resume or revise my existing Marketing Creative video project.
Use studio-producer from Video Studio instead of marketing-video for a new campaign video.
